name: chains_launch
notes: The chain flung from the wrist: a coil at the hand clinks (small glint), uncoils up and forward, then lashes down-forward toward the floor with a pale motion smear trailing the manacle. Anchor = the throwing hand. The last frame ends with the manacle ~0.6 m below/1 m ahead of the hand: hand over to chains_flight on the ground there.
